title: Intrinsic physicochemical activity at microplastic–water interfaces
title_zh: 微塑料–水界面的内在物理化学活性
abstract: Plastics have become an integral part of our modern society, largely because they are generally regarded as chemically inert under normal circumstances. However, plastics fragmented into microplastics (less than 5 mm in size) have recently raised significant public concerns, and have been detected widely across ecosystems and human tissues with increasing environmental and health risks1–5. Here we show that commodity microplastics exhibit intrinsic physicochemical activity in water, manifested by the spontaneous generation of reactive oxygen species that increases with interfacial hydrophobicity and strongly correlates with interfacial electrostatics. Ab initio calculations support these observations and reveal that hydroxide oxidation becomes energetically more favourable at increasingly hydrophobic microplastic–water interfaces through the combined effects of partial solvation and electrostatics. These interfacial properties and the resulting oxidative chemistry have direct implications for biomolecular adsorption, protein aggregation, and even cellular damage. Together, our findings challenge the prevailing paradigm of plastic inertness, identify a possibly overlooked mechanism for the detrimental effects of microplastics on health and the environment, and contribute to a fundamental understanding of the structure–activity relationship of interfacial water, which may inform the design of safer and more sustainable plastic materials. Commodity microplastics exhibit intrinsic physicochemical activity at water interfaces, manifested by spontaneous generation of reactive oxygen species, challenging the prevailing paradigm of plastic inertness, with implications for human health and the environment.
abstract_zh: 塑料已成为现代社会的重要组成部分，主要因为它们在正常情况下通常被认为是化学惰性的。然而，碎片化后的微塑料（小于5毫米）最近引起了公众的显著关注，并广泛检测在生态系统和人体组织中，随环境和健康风险而增加1–5。本研究表明，商品微塑料在水中表现出内在的物理化学活性，表现为反应性氧物种的自发产生，这随着界面的疏水性增加而增强，并与界面的静电特性强相关。第一性原理计算支持这些观察结果，并揭示随着微塑料–水界面疏水性的增加，通过部分溶剂化和静电效应的共同作用，氢氧根氧化变得更具能量可行性。这些界面性质及产生的氧化化学直接影响生物分子吸附、蛋白质聚集甚至细胞损伤。我们的研究结果挑战了塑料惰性的主流范式，鉴定出微塑料对健康和环境产生不利影响的可能被忽视的机制，并有助于界面水结构–活性关系的基本理解，这可能指导更安全、更可持续塑料材料的设计。商品微塑料在水界面表现出内在的物理化学活性，表现为反应性氧物种的自发产生，挑战了塑料惰性的主流范式，对人类健康和环境具有影响。
